frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original whole organism: narrow toothless snout and stiff armoured back. Not a whale, isolated skull or Parahupehsuchus body tube.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: 2020-NYF-84-4 nearly complete skeleton in Fang2023 Fig1A; WGSC V26007 skull/anterior skeleton in Fig1B. Primary specimen comparison, not copying author living illustration.

scale.basis: Chen et al.2014 discussion places Hupehsuchus around1m. Genus-level reconstruction target, not measured length of2020-NYF-84-4.

uncertainties: 2023 filter-feeding inference is challenged by2025 PeerJ19666; preserve uncertainty, no invented whale soft tissues.
Colour, skin, exact flesh depth and paddle outline inferred. Fossil compression not living body thickness; distal tail outline reconstructed, not fully shown in figure.
Do not substitute related short-necked Eohupehsuchus proportions or Parahupehsuchus extreme bony body tube.
